statement: Anonymous desktop and mobile visits to https://fentybeauty.com/ redirected to the Canadian English route /en-ca and displayed CAD prices.
The current Pro Filt'r Soft Matte Longwear Foundation page exposes 50 shade labels including #185, two sizes, price, availability language, description, and aggregate review facts.
The current product corresponding to the inventory's Invisible Setting Powder wording is titled Invisimatte Instant Setting + Blotting Powder and exposes Standard, Refill, and Mini sizes.
The strict public capture blocked automatic Shopify/Rivo POST requests and unapproved third-party resources; no source mutation occurred and captured rows remain source-limited.

The account entry redirects to a Rivo-backed #rivo fragment; retained DOM strings identify email/password, Google, Shop Pay, favorites, profile, addresses, and orders, but exact authenticated pixels remain unavailable.
The clone supports synthetic local accounts, persistent cart/favorites/addresses/orders, and local checkout review without real email, card fields, provider requests, or real order placement.
